Hello! The most important thing to know when playing this game is that there are 2 different forests - a bright one and a dark one. Sometimes, the bright forest has more mushrooms, sometimes the dark one will have more mushrooms. You must identify which forest has the most mushrooms at the time, and identify when it switches. 
Which forest you go to depends on which gnome you pick - Pink, Purple, Brown and Yellow gnomes all go to the dark forest. Blue, Orange, Green and Red gnomes all go to the light forest. 
When the two gnomes appear on the screen, there will always be one which goes to the light forest, and one that goes to the dark forest. They swap between the left and right sides. 

Factors like their hats, sizes etc do not matter. 
Good luck!
